title: Ha Long and Cat Ba in 4 days
summary: Hanoi, Ha Long, Cat Ba, and Hai Phong. Calm water April to June.

days.title: Day 2 — Ha Long
days.body: Take the shorter Route 1 boat, Thien Cung and Dau Go, 3–4 hours.

days.title: Day 3 — Cat Ba
days.body: Cross to Cat Ba. Lan Ha is 3–4 hours, or an 8-hour day. An adult day visit is 120,000 đồng.

days.title: Day 4 — Hai Phong
days.body: Leave through Hai Phong. Du Hang Pagoda is Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Ha Long and Cat Ba in 4 days
seoDescription: Four days from Hanoi through Ha Long and Cat Ba, out through Hai Phong.
